title: Construction Safety Manager
description:
Construction Safety Expert 
 We are looking for an experienced Construction Safety Expert responsible for implementing, monitoring, and ensuring compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (EHS) standards across construction and infrastructure project sites. 
 The candidate will be responsible for identifying workplace hazards, conducting safety inspections, monitoring high-risk construction activities, implementing preventive safety measures, and ensuring compliance with applicable statutory requirements and client safety standards. 
 The role involves monitoring civil construction, structural erection, scaffolding, excavation, work at height, lifting operations, electrical safety, and other construction-related activities to ensure a safe working environment for employees, contractors, and project personnel. 
 Roles & Responsibilities Implement and monitor project-specific EHS policies, procedures, and construction safety management systems. Conduct regular site safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments to identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions. Monitor construction activities, including excavation, concreting, reinforcement work, structural fabrication, and erection. Ensure proper implementation of Permit to Work (PTW) systems for all high-risk construction activities. Monitor work-at-height activities and ensure proper implementation of fall protection systems, safety harnesses, lifelines, and safety nets. Supervise scaffolding erection, modification, dismantling, and inspection activities to ensure compliance with safety standards. Monitor rigging, lifting, and crane operations and ensure safe lifting practices at construction sites. Ensure proper implementation of excavation and trenching safety procedures, including shoring, sloping, and barricading. Monitor electrical safety during temporary electrical installations, cable laying, equipment operation, and maintenance activities. Conduct Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), and review Method Statements before commencement of critical activities. Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by employees, workers, and contractors. Conduct safety induction, toolbox talks (TBT), and regular safety awareness training for the workforce. Monitor the safe operation of construction machinery, heavy equipment, cranes, forklifts, and material handling equipment. Ensure proper housekeeping, access and egress arrangements, barricading, and safety signage across the project site. Develop and implement emergency response plans, fire prevention procedures, evacuation arrangements, and mock drills. Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Monitor contractor safety performance and ensure compliance with project-specific EHS requirements. Coordinate with project managers, construction managers, civil engineers, contractors, and EHS teams to resolve safety-related issues. Maintain safety inspection reports, training records, incident reports, PTW records, and other EHS documentation. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly safety performance reports to project management and clients. Ensure compliance with applicable statutory safety requirements, construction regulations, and client EHS standards. Promote a proactive safety culture and drive continuous improvement in construction site safety performance.

Key Skills: Safety management,Safety engineering,Management,Industrial,Construction,Industrial safety,Training,Investigation
